corrective_action_taken: Draft PR remained unmerged while remote checks continued.
impact: HumanGate could not consider ready or merge while required checks were incomplete.
observed_symptom: One or more required checks stayed pending after draft PR creation.

preventive_rule_candidate.proposal: Final reports should classify pending required checks as HOLD_TIMEOUT, not success.

root_cause: remote checks had not completed within the local observation window
trigger_summary: Draft PR waited on remote checks before HumanGate decision.
